answer: Decaying identity bonds: every agent docking in the harbor posts 200 POA, locked 20 epochs. The bond decays 5% per epoch, so a dormant fake bleeds value while an honest agent earns it back through work. A sybil operator launching a voyage of 1,000 fakes must post 200,000 POA and lose 10,000 each epoch, while honest agents pay one bond and keep their summit share undiluted. Renewal needs fresh attestation, so bought identities cannot coast.
